content.title: You can’t watch the Magic vs 76ers play-in game on regular TV tonight — here’s why
content.text: Watch Orlando Magic guard Anthony Black, right, and Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey face off for the second time this season when their squads play each other on Tuesday, Nov. 25. (AP Photo/Matt Slocum)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s NBA slate features Paolo Banchero and the Orlando Magic facing Tyrese Maxey and the Philadelphia 76ers in this exciting NBA Eastern Conference Play-In game. Kickoff takes place at 4:30 p.m. PT/7:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. MST) on Wednesday, April 15, and the only way to watch is streaming on Amazon Prime.What TV channel is the Magic vs. 76ers NBA play-in game on tonight, or is it streaming only?When: 4:30 p.m. PT/7:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. MST) on Wednesday, April 15Where: Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PAWhat TV channel is the game on? Amazon Prime Video is not a TV channel, and there is no TV broadcast for this game. This game is only available to watch live streaming on Amazon Prime.How to watch the game streaming live: You have to sign up for Amazon Prime ($14.99/month or $139.00/year) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Prime app. To sign up, follow the instructions on Amazon Prime, and it will walk you through the process. Once you have signed up, you can download the Amazon Prime app (for Apple/iOS or for Google Android) and sign in on your phone, computer, smart TV or other streaming device.What are the Orlando Magic vs. Philadelphia 76ers spread, latest betting oddsSpread: PHI -1.5Over/Under: 222.5Get promo codes, signup deals, and free bets from our Oregon Betting News home page.Suns vs Thunder goes live tonight: Everything you need to know about how to watch Game 2Watch the Penguins vs Flyers streaming for free tonight; TV channel, time, betting oddsHow to watch Magic vs Pistons in Game 2 for free today; NBA Playoffs start time, channel, oddsJohn's focus is on helping readers find ways to watch live sports and experience them in person.
